body: Expanded market TP/SL wrong path (Medium). The expanded trade panel sends market orders with take-profit/stop-loss in a single perpsPlaceOrder call. The order entry page strips TP/SL from the market fill and attaches them via perpsUpdatePositionTPSL so triggers are position-scoped; skipping that flow mis-tags TP/SL and breaks how auto-close orders appear in the UI.
action: Already resolved on branch by commit 956fb1b0e6 — expanded panel now uses the two-step flow (place order without TP/SL, then perpsUpdatePositionTPSL for position-scoped triggers).

body: Expanded trades skip slippage guards (Medium). Expanded-view order submission does not apply the slippage configuration used on the order entry page: no maxSlippageBps is passed into formStateToOrderParams, and there is no pre-submit check for estimated slippage exceeding the user's cap. Trades blocked on the dedicated entry route can still be placed from the expanded ticket when slippage config is enabled.
action: Part (a) maxSlippageBps passed to formStateToOrderParams fixed by 956fb1b0e6; part (b) estimated-slippage pre-submit block added this run — panel snapshots form state locally, subscribes to usePerpsEstimatedSlippage, and blocks market submits exceeding the cap with a toast.
